name: Rosewood Castiglion del Bosco
positioning: Castiglion del Bosco, A Rosewood Hotel: suites and villas on a 5,000-acre wine estate around a 900-year-old borgo in Montalcino
best_for: Wine lovers interested in Brunello di Montalcino
Golfers who want a private course reserved for members and hotel guests
Families or groups wanting a villa with its own heated pool

facts.text: The hotel is set in a 900-year-old borgo.
The hotel's address is Localita Castiglion del Bosco, Montalcino, Siena.
A medieval church stands in the heart of the borgo.
Suites combine exposed wooden beams and antique furnishings with the latest technology.
Suites and villas are individually designed in a rustic-chic style, some with four-poster beds.
Osteria La Canonica is a trattoria-style Tuscan restaurant inside the medieval borgo.
The Lobby Bar has a Tuscan fireplace and serves light snacks, afternoon tea and nightcaps.
The estate has a spa and an infinity pool.
The Club at Castiglion del Bosco is a private golf club reserved exclusively for members and guests of the hotel.
The estate has an 18-hole golf course.
Rosewood Explorers is set among green meadows and tall cypress trees, a setting for children to play.

highlights.text: The Castiglion del Bosco winery is one of the historic producers of Brunello di Montalcino.
The villas were crafted from restored 17th- and 18th-century farmhouses.
Each villa has a private heated pool, and some have wood-burning pizza ovens, a home theater or a tennis court.
Villas come with a Land Rover Defender or similar 4x4 vehicle for guests' use during their stay.
La Canonica Cooking School offers hands-on cooking classes in traditional Italian cuisine.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a car for exploring nearby towns.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive estate experience.
